messages:
mira: quick heads-up — onboarding a HF `tokenizer` for the new mpt-variant. observed ZWNJ (U+200C) behaviour mismatch after HF->Redwood conversion. splitting in chat templates is wrong.

sam: repro steps?

mira: paste: input string "تستfoo\u200cbar" (simplified), hf tokenizer keeps the ZWNJ as part of a token, redwood conversion strips it and byte-fallback inserts `\uFFFD` -> tokens shift.

jon: can you paste the exact token lists?

mira: HF tokens: [`"\u062A"`,`"\u0633"`,`"\u062A"`,`"\u200Cbar"`,`"foo"`]. Redwood tokens: [`"\u062A"`,`"\u0633"`,`"\u062A"`,`"bar"`,`"foo"`]. chat template now thinks context boundary changed.

sam: ugh. likely pre-tokenizer unicode_normalizer step applied differently. HF normalizer sometimes NFC->NFKC depending on config; our conversion pipeline currently runs NFKC unconditionally which collapses ZWNJ?

jon: ZWNJ isn't a compatibility char; NFKC shouldn't remove it but some normalizers can map it out if combined with byte-fallback. Could also be our byte_fallback table mapping it to empty.

mira: confirmed: conversion code has a tiny fallback rule: if codepoint < 0x20 or in control list -> drop. we accidentally included U+200C in that list during earlier sanitization. facepalm.

sam: ok that explains drop. Is this only in chat template rendering or also in generation?

mira: both. generation logits align to token ids, but downstream chat template segmentation compares tokenized prompt vs template anchors; when anchor loses zwnj it's offset by 1 token -> function calls misfire.

jon: priority: fix conversion mapping to not drop ZWNJ and add unit test for nonspacing/formatting marks. Also need migration plan: some models already converted with the bug.

mira: suggested patch: change sanitizer to only drop C0 controls and explicit zero-width no-break space (U+FEFF), not general format chars. here's snippet:```diff
- if (cp <= 0x1F || is_control(cp)) return; // old
+ if ((cp <= 0x1F && cp != 0x09 && cp != 0x0A && cp != 0x0D) || cp == 0xFEFF) return; // preserve format marks like ZWNJ (0x200C)
```

tess: also add a conversion flag `preserve_formatting_chars` to config.json so Private deployments can opt-in?

sam: prefer default preserve = true, opt-out for weird legacy models. less footguns.

mira: created a quick eval to run token-diff on the webhook testset (arabic/urdu samples + ZWNJ cases). initial run: 12% of samples differ in token alignment.

dev-bot: deploy bot: created branch `fix/zwnj-preserve` — build queued (#3421).

jon: assign to mira for patch + add ctest in tokenizer tests. can someone run conversion on the small sample and push regenerated artifacts to staging?

tess: I'll run conversion on the 100-model sample this afternoon and report.

mira: thanks. I'll open PR with sanitizer fix and test vectors, and add a quickline in README about special token expectations.

sam: lovely. quick note: add a fuzz test for control vs format chars. caught a few other private-use weirdness earlier.

mira: adding that to the PR. will @channel when merged and when we rerun staging conversions. :thumbsup:

jon: perfect.
